name: Agent Memory
description: Adds long-term memory to Work, Code, and Team. It recalls relevant memories before answering and saves useful information after a turn. Team also saves and retrieves conclusions within the same team.

display_description.zh: 为 Work、Code 和 Team 提供长期记忆。回答前自动召回相关记忆，对话结束后保存用户偏好和项目经验，并提供记忆检索及文档读写工具。Team 还可保存和召回本团队的结论。
display_description.en: Adds long-term memory to Work, Code, and Team. It recalls memories before answering, saves preferences and project knowledge after a turn, and provides tools to search and edit memory documents. Team can also save and recall its own conclusions.
